observations: Top-opening chest freezer with a silver-colored lid and a central handle.
The front panel is light-colored with a large manufacturer sticker.
The sticker reads '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION' and '3 YEARS WARRANTY'.
A brand logo is visible on the top left corner of the lid, but the text is too small to read.
The control panel on the right side has a dial and two indicator lights.
The unit is plugged into a wall socket.
The exterior shows some surface dirt and minor scuffs.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not explicitly stated on the visible sticker or the manufacturer's logo.
No photos of the interior or a power-on test are provided.

risks.risk: The unit may not be cooling or may have a faulty thermostat.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior showing frost or a thermometer reading, and a video of the unit running.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or have a gas leak.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with sound and a close-up of the rear compressor area.

risks.risk: The capacity may be significantly lower than 250 liters.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate, usually found on the back or inside the lid.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the interior of the freezer.
Video of the freezer running with sound.
Photo of the rear of the unit showing the compressor.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
